title: G7 v3: automatic routine fix rounds with a lineage-wide round cap, escalation keyed to the hold instance, placed after merge_reviewed and before the autonomous Planner block (spec reviews T-0293 and T-0312 folded in)
spec:
Replaces T-0296 (spec review T-0312) and T-0272 (T-0293). Build on goal/T-0260 daemon.py after G6 v4 (stage leases, clear_stage) and planner_runs.py. Today a held task waits for the Planner to write a fix-round spec and to mark the original merged afterwards; held tasks carry hold_reason and resume_hint (tests-green failures, rebase conflicts), review tasks carry result.comments (path, line, issue, severity), constraints.fix_round_for makes spawn.base_for cut the fix worktree from the held task's branch.
Design:
1. Lineage: root(task) walks constraints.fix_round_for up to the task without it. lineage(root) = root plus every task whose root() is that root. auto_fix_round(pool) runs in tick() after the dispatch, gate and merge_reviewed loop and before the autonomous Planner block (a task held this tick is picked up the same tick). For each held execute task: skip when any non-failed task in its lineage carries fix_round_for pointing at this task (a fix round already exists); routine when hold_reason is gate_red and resume_hint.failures names at least one FAIL or ERROR test id, or hold_reason starts 'review request_changes' and every comment of that review has a path inside the task scope; and the number of tasks in the lineage with constraints.auto_round set is below [daemon].auto_fix_rounds (pool.toml, default 2), counted across the whole chain. Otherwise escalate: hold instance key = the timestamp of the latest event that set status held on this task (fallback: review_held_at or gated_at); stamp pipeline.auto_fix_skipped[<key>] = now under the lock and notify once per key; a later, different hold on the same task gets its own key and its own notification.
2. The fix task: title 'fix round <n>: <root title>' with n = lineage auto rounds + 1; spec rendered from a new .orchestrator/prompts/fix-round.md (root id and title, held task id, the failed acceptance criteria: those mentioning a failing test id, else all; failure text capped 3,000 chars in a fenced block labelled data; review comments as path:line issue lines; branch and head sha; keep every original criterion); same scope, complexity, tier and constraints plus fix_round_for = the held task id and auto_round = n; inputs = [held task, review id if any]; created under the bus lock, one per hold key (dedupe on the key).
3. planner_runs.decision_points() skips a held task when any non-failed task with constraints.fix_round_for == its id exists, so [planner].autonomous never launches a Planner for a hold the daemon handled; when auto_fix_round escalates, the decision point stays available.
4. Reconciliation: in gate() direct-merge and merge_reviewed(), after a task with fix_round_for merges, walk the chain to the root setting each ancestor status done, merged_into = target, merged_via = 'fix round <fix id> <sha>', hold_reason None.
5. README Pipeline 'Automatic fix rounds' paragraph (routine/escalate rule, lineage cap, hold-key notification, placement); pool.toml [daemon] auto_fix_rounds = 2.
Tests in tests/test_daemon.py: test_auto_fix_round_on_gate_red, test_auto_fix_round_on_review_comments_in_scope, test_no_auto_fix_when_comments_outside_scope, test_lineage_cap_across_chained_fix_rounds (fix round of a fix round stops at the cap), test_escalation_notifies_once_per_hold_key (two ticks one notify; a new hold on the same task notifies again), test_same_tick_pickup (a task held during gate() gets its fix round in the same tick), test_fix_round_merge_reconciles_chain; tests/test_planner_runs.py::test_held_decision_skipped_when_fix_round_exists.
acceptance: the generated fix task passes .claude/hooks/require-acceptance.sh and carries constraints.fix_round_for and auto_round
README and pool.toml document the rule, the lineage cap, the hold-key notification and the placement
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

spec_review_risks.issue: Design point 2 doesn't say the fix-round task must carry over parent=<held task's parent>. bus.create_task defaults parent=None. merge.merge() targets f"goal/{parent}" or falls back to "integration" when parent is unset, and planner_runs.decision_points()'s children_by_parent grouping (keyed on parent) would never see the fix round as a goal child, so 'closable' can fire while it's still in flight and the merge lands on the wrong branch.

Reconciliation is scoped to 'gate() direct-merge and merge_reviewed()' only, but sweep_leases() has a third, independent merge.merge() call for an expired gated_at lease with reviews_expected==0 (around line 719-723). A fix round merged via that lease-retry path would skip chain reconciliation entirely, reproducing the documented gotcha ('a rebased fix round hides the original task from already_merged', gotchas.md 2026-09-18). None of the listed tests exercise this path.

The gate_red 'routine' rule requires finding a FAIL/ERROR test id inside resume_hint.failures, but that field is raw grep output from tests-green.sh across pytest/npm/tsc, not a structured test-id list; the spec never defines the extraction rule, risking systematic misclassification for non-pytest failures.

hold_reason for a review hold only names the first rejected review (rejected[0]); at complexity>=7 two reviews can both reject. If the routine scope-check only inspects the review named in hold_reason instead of every rejected review, an out-of-scope comment on the un-named second review is missed, wrongly classifying an unsafe hold as routine.

The new daemon-side hold-instance key (latest held event, fallback review_held_at/gated_at) duplicates planner_runs._held_at(), an existing, tested implementation of the same concept but with a different fallback list (review_held_at/spec_review_held_at). Two divergent implementations of 'what identifies this hold instance' risk drifting apart.
No stale()/goal-closed guard before generating an auto fix round, unlike dispatch()/gate()/merge_reviewed() which all skip a task whose parent goal is already done.

events.reason: superseded by G7 v4 (complexity 5, spec review waived after three rounds) after spec review T-0321; mark T-0272, T-0296, T-0320 done+merged_into when v4 merges
